The test image shows green sugarcane leaves with:
- Small scattered tan/brownish-yellow spots across the leaf surface
- A lighter/white area along the midrib

This points to **leaf** as the affected part. Top candidates: Brown_Spot, Yellow_Spot, Leaf_Scald. Let me view one reference from each of the 8 classes (skipping Grassy_Shoot which shows a bushy whole-plant appearance clearly different from this).

**Summary of all 8 class comparisons:**

- **Brown_Spot**: Shows elongated brownish streaks, not discrete round spots
- **Yellow_Spot**: Small scattered yellowish spots on green leaf — **closest match** to test image
- **Leaf_Scald**: White band/stripe across leaf — not matching
- **Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus**: Diffuse mosaic/patchy yellow-green pattern — not matching
- **Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv**: Longitudinal streaks — not matching
- **Yellow_Leaf**: Entire leaf yellowing/browning — not matching
- **Pokkah_Boeng**: Twisted leaves with vein streaks — not matching
- **Sett_Rot**: Stem rot with dry brown tissues — not matching

The test image shows green sugarcane leaves with many small discrete scattered tan/yellow spots, which visually aligns most closely with the Yellow_Spot reference (SugarLeaf_ID_100.jpg) showing similar small scattered yellowish spots on otherwise green leaves.
